originalTitle: Kinder Morgan (KMI) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: In the most recent trading session, Kinder Morgan (KMI) closed at $31.6, indicating a -1.16% shift from the previous trading day.
content:
In the latest close session, Kinder Morgan (KMI) was down 1.16% at $31.60. This change lagged the S&P 500's 1.06% gain on the day. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 1.18%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 1.4%.

The stock of oil and natural gas pipeline and storage company has risen by 2.73% in the past month, lagging the Oils-Energy sector's gain of 4.7% and overreaching the S&P 500's gain of 2.46%.

The investment community will be closely monitoring the performance of Kinder Morgan in its forthcoming earnings report. In that report, analysts expect Kinder Morgan to post earnings of $0.33 per share. This would mark year-over-year growth of 13.79%. Simultaneously, our latest consensus estimate expects the revenue to be $4.49 billion, showing a 8.33% escalation compared to the year-ago quarter.

In terms of the entire fiscal year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates predict earnings of $1.54 per share and a revenue of $18.49 billion, indicating changes of +18.46% and +9.19%, respectively, from the former year.

It is also important to note the recent changes to analyst estimates for Kinder Morgan. These revisions help to show the ever-changing nature of near-term business trends. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Empirical research indicates that these revisions in estimates have a direct correlation with impending stock price performance. We developed the Zacks Rank to capitalize on this phenomenon. Our system takes these estimate changes into account and delivers a clear, actionable rating model.

The Zacks Rank system, running from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), holds an admirable track record of superior performance, independently audited, with #1 stocks contributing an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has shifted 0.74% upward. As of now, Kinder Morgan holds a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

Looking at its valuation, Kinder Morgan is holding a Forward P/E ratio of 20.73. This valuation marks a premium compared to its industry average Forward P/E of 20.35.

Also, we should mention that KMI has a PEG ratio of 2.27. The PEG ratio is similar to the widely-used P/E ratio, but this metric also takes the company's expected earnings growth rate into account. The Oil and Gas - Production and Pipelines was holding an average PEG ratio of 1.9 at yesterday's closing price.

The Oil and Gas - Production and Pipelines industry is part of the Oils-Energy sector. This group has a Zacks Industry Rank of 188, putting it in the bottom 24% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the vigor of our specific industry groups by computing the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks incorporated in the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

You can find more information on all of these metrics, and much more, on Zacks.com.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，金德摩根 (KMI) 股价仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 在最近的交易日中，金德摩根 (KMI) 收于 31.6 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.16%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易日中，金德摩根 (KMI) 下跌 1.16%，至 31.60 美元。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数当日 1.06% 的涨幅。与此同时，道指上涨 1.18%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 1.4%。

过去一个月，石油和天然气管道及储存公司的股票上涨了2.73%，落后于石油能源板块4.7%的涨幅，超过了标准普尔500指数2.46%的涨幅。

投资界将密切关注金德摩根即将发布的收益报告的表现。在该报告中，分析师预计金德摩根将公布每股收益 0.33 美元。这将标志着同比增长 13.79%。同时，我们最新的共识预计收入为 44.9 亿美元，较去年同期增长 8.33%。

就整个财年而言，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 1.54 美元，营收为 184.9 亿美元，较上年分别变化 +18.46% 和 +9.19%。

同样重要的是要注意金德摩根分析师估计的最新变化。这些修订有助于显示近期业务趋势不断变化的性质。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

实证研究表明，这些预测的修正与即将到来的股价表现直接相关。我们开发了 Zacks Rank 来利用这一现象。我们的系统会考虑这些估计变化，并提供清晰、可操作的评级模型。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人钦佩的卓越业绩记录，经过独立审计，自 1988 年以来#1 股票贡献的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计向上移动了 0.74%。截至目前，金德摩根的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

从估值来看，金德摩根的远期市盈率为 20.73。与行业平均远期市盈率 20.35 相比，这一估值存在溢价。

另外，我们应该提到 KMI 的 PEG 比率为 2.27。 PEG比率与广泛使用的市盈率类似，但该指标也考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。按昨天收盘价计算，石油和天然气 - 生产和管道部门的平均 PEG 率为 1.9。

石油和天然气 - 生产和管道行业是石油能源行业的一部分。该群体的 Zacks 行业排名为 188，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 24%。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算特定行业组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们特定行业组的活力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
